caption: The drawing consists of a single, centrally placed, dark gray silhouette of a human figure with wings, depicted in a horizontal, flying position facing to the right. The figure appears to be holding and blowing into a trumpet or horn with both hands. The outline of the trumpet extends from the figure’s mouth with a dotted line, indicating the incomplete or suggested continuation of the object. The background is plain and a light tan or off-white color with no additional objects or shading, and the entire composition is contained within a simple, thin, rectangular border that is itself centered within the larger background.
title: Weather Vane
